Ministry of Education, Higher Education and Vocational EducationAmendments

Competitive Examination for the recruitment of Graduates to the Sri Lanka Teachers’ Service for Sinhala, Tamil and English medium Teacher Vacancies in National and Provincial Schools of the Island - 2026
Notification published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2474/19 dated 02.02.2026 regarding the calling of applications for the aforesaid competitive examination;

There shall be no impediment for those who have completed the degree qualifications to apply in terms of this Gazette notification: graduates who were in the public service as at 10.02.2023 and remain in service to date, who were ineligible to apply under the Gazette notifications mentioned in Note 2 above as at 10.02.2023, but had not exceeded 40 years of age by 10.02.2023 and completed the degree qualifications after 10.02.2023 and before 30.06.2025; and those who were in the public service as at 10.02.2023 but have since resigned from said position with formal approval, having completed the degree qualifications prior to 30.06.2025. Is as follows -

There shall be no impediment for those who have completed the degree qualifications to apply in terms of this Gazette notification: graduates who were in the public service as at 10.02.2023 and remain in service to date, who were ineligible to apply under the Gazette notifications mentioned in Note 2 above as at 10.02.2023, but had not exceeded 40 years of age by 10.02.2023 and completed the degree qualifications after 10.02.2023 and before 05.03.2026; and those who were in the public service as at 10.02.2023 but have since resigned from said position with formal approval, having completed the degree qualifications prior to 05.03.2026.

The opportunity will be given to these applicants, only if there are further vacancies after making recruitments from the applicants who are permanent residents of the province for the teacher vacancies existing in the additional province.

Remarks: The applicants; who are not permanent residents in Eastern Province, can apply only for the subjects of Science, Mathematics, English, Information Technology, Technology Stream and Counseling in Eastern Province. Is as follows -

The opportunity will be given to these applicants, only if there are further vacancies after making recruitments from the applicants who are permanent residents of the province for the teacher vacancies existing in the additional province. The terms and conditions to be imposed in granting appointments to candidates who qualify for appointments in another province shall be determined by the respective Provincial Public Service Commission.
• In Section 5.1 under the Educational and other qualifications

As per the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Teachers’ Service published in the Extraordinary Gazette No.1885/38 dated 23.10.2014 of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, the applicants should have fulfilled the following qualifications as at 30.06.2025. Is as follows -

As per the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Teachers’ Service published in the Extraordinary Gazette No.1885/38 dated 23.10.2014 of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, the applicants should have fulfilled the following qualifications as at 05.03.2026.
Age required for the recruitment to the post should have been fulfilled by 10.02.2023 and all other qualifications should have been fulfilled by 30.06.2025. Is as follows -
Age required for the recruitment to the post should have been fulfilled by 10.02.2023 and all other qualifications should have been fulfilled by 05.03.2026.
2. The following Schedule 5 shall be applicable, in place of Schedule 5 of the said Notification.
3. In addition to the matters in 1 and 2 above, all other provisions mentioned in the Notification published in Gazette Extraordinary No. 2474/19 dated 02.02.2026 shall remain unchanged.
